subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency — follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Svensson <julia.svensson@nordbank.se>, Erik Lund <erik.lund@nordbank.se>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency — discovery recap

Hi Julia / Erik —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side after the call: 

- Goal: Nordbank wants production workloads to remain in-scope for EU-only data residency and meet strict key management requirements; dev/test can be more flexible.
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (fastest for dev/proof-of-concept), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput), Private (VPC/on-prem for production with customer-managed keys).
- Clarifications requested: 
  - Confirmed production must not cross-region (no cross-region routing for EU-prod).
  - You asked about KMS/HSM support and audit logs retention for Private and Dedicated.
  - Region availability: you preferred eu-central-1 but asked about eu-west-1 as fallback.

Attachments: I've attached a short quicksheet on deployment options (redwood-deployment-options-quicksheet.pdf).

Proposed next steps: 
1) We'll send an architecture diagram showing Hosted/Dedicated/Private variants and where keys/logs live (will attach).
2) Aditya and Neha to follow up on KMS integration and region availability SLA details.
3) Schedule a technical workshop next week to validate network peering and SOC 2 controls.

Are you available for a 60-min technical workshop on Tue 2026-08-10 or Wed 2026-08-11 (EU morning)?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a short PoC.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Julia Svensson <julia.svensson@nordbank.se>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erik Lund <erik.lund@nordbank.se>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 07:28:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency — discovery recap

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points from our side: 

- Production requirement: all production customer data must remain in EU; no cross-region replication or routing for PII. We need customer-managed KMS for production keys (BYOK) and support for HSM-backed keys if possible.
- For non-prod (dev, staging) we can use hosted EU regions.
- Preferred regions: primary eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), fallback eu-west-1 (Ireland) acceptable for secondary workloads only.
- Audit/logging: logs must be retained for 7 years and accessible for audit; you mentioned you can provide audit exports and Syslog/CloudTrail-style events — please confirm format and retention controls.

I'm attaching our security questionnaire and a short network requirements doc (nordbank-security-questionnaire.pdf).

We're available for a technical workshop on Wed 2026-08-11 at 09:00 CEST.

One additional ask: can you confirm whether the Hosted API ever routes to non-EU endpoints for model-hosting (in case of overflow/fallback)? We need to ensure the Hosted option can be restricted to EU-only endpoints during the engagement.

Regards,
Julia Svensson
Head of AI Infrastructure
Nordbank
julia.svensson@nordbank.se

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Svensson <julia.svensson@nordbank.se>, Erik Lund <erik.lund@nordbank.se>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency — discovery recap

Hi Julia —

Great — thanks for the questionnaire, we'll review and provide the answers prior to the workshop. Quick answers inline to your key asks: 

- Hosted routing: Hosted API can be locked to EU-only regions for your account; we do have cross-region routing capabilities for global customers but for an EU-only contract we can disable fallbacks to non-EU endpoints.
- Region availability: We currently operate hosted endpoints in eu-central-1 and eu-west-1. Dedicated capacity can be provisioned in either region; Private (VPC/on-prem) obviously sits in your environment and we'll validate network peering options.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations for Dedicated and Hosted (when you provide the key in a supported cloud KMS). For Private deployments we can integrate with your HSM. We'll include an integration matrix in our follow-up.
- Auditing & logs: We can stream structured audit logs (S3/Cloud Storage + CloudTrail-compatible events) and support long-term retention/export; we'll confirm retention tooling for 7-year archives (S3 Glacier / cold storage) in the security answers.

I've attached a proposed production architecture diagram that shows the three deployment variants and where keys/logs live (nordbank-prod-arch-diagram.pdf). We also attached the quicksheet earlier.

Next steps: 
- Aditya will send region SLA and Dedicated capacity lead times.
- Neha will draft the KMS/HSM integration details and the audit export formats for the questionnaire.
- Schedule: Technical workshop confirmed for Wed 2026-08-11 09:00 CEST — I'll send a calendar invite.

If you want, we can include a short PoC scope in the calendar invite (1-week POC: dev workloads on Hosted EU, production validation on Private with a single model).

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Svensson <julia.svensson@nordbank.se>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 14:32:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency — internal next steps

Aditya / Neha —

Thanks — quick internal to align before the workshop on Wednesday: 

Action items:
- Aditya: please pull region capacity lead times for Dedicated in eu-central-1 and eu-west-1 and confirm typical provisioning timeline (hours/days/weeks) and any required minimum commit. Also prepare a short note on SLA for latency and cross-region failover controls.
- Neha: draft KMS/HSM integration matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) + exact audit log export formats and retention options (including cold storage).
- I'll prepare the PoC scope doc and a runbook for the workshop (network checklist, sample prov endpoints, sample cURL and SDK calls).

Also flagging the Nordbank questionnaire they sent — please annotate sections that need legal/security review so we can expedite.

I'll mark the calendar for Wed 2026-08-11 09:00 CEST and include the PoC scope draft.

Thanks,
Marissa
